author: Acceqted
body:
Hey there...


No, I didn't get kicked out of Cronus. I just feel like I'm not right for the team. I really enjoy scrimming with them and I wish them the best of luck in the future. I had a blast playing with you guys in the tourney, it was a lot of fun.

Moving on...

I'm looking for an active team, that scrims often. I may not be the best pvp'er but I'm definitely not the worst :) and hope to improve.


Position: Rusher
Secondary Position: Defender
Age: 13
Access to TS: Yep
Active: Kind of have to be, but yes.
Skype: hovdoge

Would appreciate vouches <3
